$schema: FAQ entries shown on contact and product pages. Update as Arisa receives questions.

items.q: How do I reserve a doll?
items.a: Add the doll to your basket and complete the adoption form. Arisa will reply within 24 hours with bank transfer details and confirm her availability.

items.q: Can I commission a custom doll?
items.a: Yes. Use the contact form and share your reference photographs and any details. Bespoke commissions take ten to sixteen weeks.
Worldwide. Every doll travels in a linen-lined cradle box with full tracking and insurance.
Within Europe: 3–7 working days. Outside Europe: 7–14 working days, depending on customs.

items.q: How do I care for a reborn doll?
items.a: Keep her out of direct sunlight and away from heat. Clean gently with a soft, slightly damp cloth. Never machine wash. Brush mohair with a soft baby brush.

items.q: Can I return an adopted doll?
items.a: Each doll is one-of-one and made by hand, so we do not accept returns. We do guarantee safe arrival — if anything is damaged in transit, please write to us within 48 hours.
